Complete case inventory with separate passed, failed, error, blocked and skipped counts.

## Exceptions

EvaluationError for invalid inputs, incompatible resume or a failed observer.

## Remarks

Every transition emits a deeply immutable checkpoint before its event. Unchanged case evidence retains object identity across checkpoints. Cases run concurrently; exchanges within a case remain sequential. A failed expectation does not stop other cases. No request is automatically retried. Cancellation and deadlines cannot undo an external effect; inspect receipts before retrying it. Resume requires an identical suite/selection/target/adapter fingerprint. Only adapters declaring supportsResume may resume an incomplete conversation prefix.
